correctness.rationale: The quadric-web determinant gives the exact quartic over \(\mathbb F_5\); affine Gröbner ideals yield precisely six geometric nodes, with invertible Hessians. Exhausting every one of 156 rational projective points and 806 rational lines verifies 25 and the complete 6x5/60x2 incidence; binary degree four makes six-point vanishing on an \(\mathbb F_5\)-line a proof of containment. The genus-two curve \(y^2=x^5-x\) has \(L(T)=(1-5T^2)^2\) by exact \(\mathbb F_5\)/\(\mathbb F_{25}\) point counts and the trace-zero nonsquare argument. The odd-characteristic Weddle/Kummer birationality and equality of K3 minimal resolutions give counts for all n, not an extrapolation. Subtraction of the 25-line union and the generating series prove the open zeta. Both executable certificates from actual package paths were replayed.

value.rationale: The exact point-free open locus is the natural complement of the 25 distinguished lines of a maximally rational six-branch-point Weddle model, not a contrived subset. The 66-to-zero saturation over \(\mathbb F_5\) but 460 complementary points over \(\mathbb F_{25}\), full open zeta and exact rational-line classification are meaningful finite-field arithmetic invariants of a special supersingular K3 model. The combinatorial and Frobenius comparisons make the result more than merely re-enumerating classical lines.
